subject: Procurement intake: aligning stakeholders & scheduling a procurement intake session
body:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement intake: aligning stakeholders & scheduling a procurement intake session

Hi Jane / Acme procurement team,

Thanks for the quick sync last week — excited to get the formal procurement intake scheduled so we can align on timelines and deliverables. To make the session efficient, goal is to:
- Confirm procurement checklist (SOC2 evidence, DPA, contractual contacts)
- Walk through hosting model options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and associated timelines
- Identify technical owners for a short demo + security follow-up (SE + customer security)
- Agree next steps and mutual action plan

Proposed 60-minute windows (all times PT):
- Tue May 11, 9:00–10:00 AM
- Tue May 11, 3:00–4:00 PM
- Wed May 12, 8:00–9:00 AM

I've attached our procurement checklist and a short pre-demo deck so your team can skim before the call. If none of these work, happy to open a couple more slots; please indicate preferred attendees from your side (procurement, legal, security, infra) and any blocking dates.

Attaching: redwood_procurement_checklist.pdf, pre-demo-slide-deck.pptx

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

---

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-corp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com, Tom Li <tom.li@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement intake: aligning stakeholders & scheduling a procurement intake session

Thanks Sean — appreciate the outline.

We are keen to move forward. Our procurement team and legal would like to attend; security has requested a brief pre-call (15–20 min) the day before to confirm logging and data residency items.

Availability from our side (PT):
- Tue May 11, 3:00–4:00 PM — preferred
- Wed May 12, 8:00–9:00 AM — possible but prefer the afternoon if you have other options

Can you add a 15-minute pre-security touchpoint on Mon May 10 at 4:30 PM PT? If that works, please invite our security lead, Tom Li (tom.li@acme-corp.com), and procurement@acme-corp.com.

Also, quick ask: can you surface a SOC 2 summary and data retention policy in advance? Our legal will review.

Thanks,
Jane
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
---

On Sun, May 9, 2027 at 10:12 AM Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> (original message above)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-corp.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement intake: aligning stakeholders & scheduling a procurement intake session

Thanks Jane — 3:00–4:00 PM PT on May 11 works well for the customer-facing demo.

A couple quick notes:
- I'll run the demo portion (~20 minutes) focused on integration surface and latency/cost controls (your platform engineers will likely be interested in the Optimize features).
- If your infra team wants a deeper SE-focused session, Dev can run a technical deep-dive in the following week.

If security insists on a separate pre-call on Mon May 10 at 4:30 PM PT, I'm happy to join that short sync as well.

Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

On Mon, May 10, 2027 at 08:27 AM Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-corp.com> wrote:
> Thanks Sean — appreciate the outline.

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-corp.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 07:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement intake: aligning stakeholders & scheduling a procurement intake session

Appreciate the details. Quick scheduling note: I have a conflict on Tue May 11 at 3:00 PM PT — would 4:00–4:45 PM PT work instead? If not, I can join remotely for the first half and hop off for an internal support call.

On the checklist items Jane mentioned:
- SOC 2: attaching a short SOC2 summary (soc2-summary.pdf) — includes our auditor and last test date.
- Data retention & logs: we retain inference logs for up to 30 days by default in Hosted; Dedicated/Private options can be configured longer per contract. We'll flag options in the intake meeting.
- For the security pre-call, I'll prepare expected firewall rules and the list of least-privilege IAM roles we recommend.

SE ask for Acme infra:
- A sandbox account with test endpoints (or IP allowlist) to validate short demo if you prefer
- Expected max sequence length & throughput targets (rough estimates are fine)

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0114

On Tue, May 11, 2027 at 07:27 AM Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-corp.com> wrote:
> Sean / team — 3:00–4:00 PM PT is our preferred time. Tom (security) can do Mon May 10 at 4:30 PM PT for a quick pre-call.

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme-corp.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com, Tom Li <tom.li@acme-corp.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement intake: aligning stakeholders & scheduling a procurement intake session

Thanks everyone — locking this in. Final calendar details: 
- Procurement intake (60 min): Tue May 11, 2027, 3:00–4:00 PM PT (Zoom) — agenda: intro, procurement checklist, 20-min demo, Q&A, next steps. Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwoodinference.com/invite/ACME-042-intake
- Security pre-call (15 min): Mon May 10, 2027, 4:30–4:45 PM PT (phone) — attendees: Tom Li (Acme security), Dev (SE), Sean

Attachments included in the invite: redwood_procurement_checklist.pdf, pre-demo-slide-deck.pptx, soc2-summary.pdf

Action items / next steps:
- Acme: confirm if sandbox IP allowlist or temporary test credentials will be provided for the demo (Tom / infra) — Tom, can you advise?
- Redwood (Dev): prepare firewall / IAM guidance and a short list of expected logs for the security call.
- Redwood (Aisha): final demo script and 3–4 integration slides to highlight quick wins for your infra team.

If anything changes, ping me and we'll adjust. Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Sean
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood_procurement_checklist.pdf (attachment), pre-demo-slide-deck.pptx (attachment), soc2-summary.pdf (attachment)
